title: Dry Bean Classifier
tagline: Classify seven bean varieties from image-derived shape features - and see what accuracy hides.
question: Can we tell seven dry bean varieties apart from shape measurements alone - for every variety, not just the common ones?
audience: Students building their first honest classification project.

source.name: Dry Bean Dataset
source.citation: Dry Bean [Dataset]. (2020). UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C50S4B

lesson.title: Accuracy can hide a failing class
lesson.summary: Classes are imbalanced (BOMBAY is rare). Use a stratified split so every class is evaluated, report macro F1 and per-class scores, and keep preprocessing inside a pipeline so the scaler only sees training data.

parameters.name: model
parameters.label: Classifier
parameters.help: Logistic regression or random forest, both inside a StandardScaler pipeline.

challenges.title: Fix SIRA vs. DERMASON
challenges.description: Engineer features or try gradient boosting to separate the two most-confused classes.
challenges.outcome: Higher F1 on both, shown in the confusion matrix.

challenges.title: Cross-validated comparison
challenges.description: Use StratifiedKFold(5) to compare three models.

challenges.title: Feature importance
challenges.description: Use permutation importance on the held-out set.
challenges.outcome: A ranked bar chart and a sentence on correlated features.
